title: Passive fin-stabilised flight
description:
Uncontrolled flight of the TVC rocket with the gimbal locked at 0 deg, launched from an 18 ft rail at 6 deg towards East from Midland, TX, simulated with the 6-DOF nonlinear model (ISA atmosphere, Mach-dependent aerodynamics, variable mass, rail phase) through apogee, drogue descent and main-chute descent from 300 m AGL.

The 'wind' variant adds a 6 m/s wind from the East at 10 m with 1/7 power-law shear, Gauss-Markov turbulence (1.5 m/s) and a 5 m/s 1-cos side gust at t = 3 s: the fin-stabilised rocket weathercocks into the wind and then drifts downwind under canopy.

variants.label: No wind
variants.notes: Rocket: TVC sounding rocket (6 in, AeroTech M1845NT) - OpenRocket 23.09 model. Parameters: data/rocket_params.json (OpenRocket-derived). Motor: M1845NT (8093 Ns). 'OR check' metrics/plots (nominal variant) re-fly the ascent with the OpenRocket run's wind and compare against data/openrocket_flight.csv.
